responsibilities: Design and deliver dimensional and semantic data models for analytics.
Define and maintain KPIs, conformed dimensions and consistent data definitions.
Develop and optimise SQL and PySpark pipelines using Databricks.
Ensure high standards of data quality, testing, performance and observability.
Lead modelling reviews and contribute to technical and architectural decisions.
Contribute to CI/CD, automation, testing and data governance standards.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure high standards of data quality, testing, performance and observability.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The posting is entirely correctness-oriented - robust pipelines, well-modelled and governed data, a dedicated quality/testing/observability bullet - with no speed or shipping language.
evidence.domain_risk: We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the design and delivery of curated, analytics-ready data within our Lakehouse environment.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The posting names no sector, product or business domain and invokes no financial-reporting, regulatory or audit language, so the default is business-decision impact.
evidence.collaboration_width: No distinctly named partner teams or functions appear in the JD.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Proven experience with Databricks and Lakehouse architectures.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A Lakehouse with Databricks and Unity Catalog is already in place and the role contributes to existing architectural decisions, but no data sub-teams or scale are described.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop and optimise SQL and PySpark pipelines using Databricks.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Despite its brevity every bullet names concrete technical work - PySpark pipelines on Databricks, conformed dimensions, modelling reviews - rather than generic stakeholder language.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: own the data serving layer, and ensure data is well-modelled, governed, performant and ready for consumption across analytics and BI
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The output is the serving and semantic layer consumed by analytics and BI - the data function's own consumers - with no business function named.
evidence.autonomy_level: We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the design and delivery of curated, analytics-ready data within our Lakehouse environment.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role leads design and delivery, owns the serving layer, defines KPIs and definitions, and leads modelling and architectural reviews.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is never mentioned in the posting, so no AI skill is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure high standards of data quality, testing, performance and observability.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality, testing and observability form an owned responsibility bullet with an 'Ensure' verb, and a second bullet has the candidate contributing to testing and governance standards.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Contribute to CI/CD, automation, testing and data governance standards.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The risk register is operational - quality, performance and observability of the pipelines - with no compliance exposure or stakeholder-trust framing.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design and deliver dimensional and semantic data models for analytics.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The dominant verbs are design, deliver, define and develop - creating new models, pipelines and standards rather than remediating existing ones.
evidence.loss_aversion: Ensure high standards of data quality, testing, performance and observability - the fear expressed is degraded pipeline quality and performance rather than bad data reaching decision-makers or regulators. Note: this is a recruitment/consultancy posting; the end client is not named.
